mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROUTE ( ROUTE_SEQ, SCHEDULE_SCHEDULE_ID, DEPARTURE_STATION_ID, ARRIVAL_STATION_ID ) VALUES ( #{routeSeq}, #{scheduleId}, #{departureStationId}, #{arrivalStationId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
R.ROUTE_ID AS routeId,
R.ROUTE_SEQ AS routeSeq,
R.SCHEDULE_SCHEDULE_ID AS scheduleId,
R.DEPARTURE_STATION_ID AS departureStationId,
R.ARRIVAL_STATION_ID AS arrivalStationId,
DS.STATION_NAME AS departureStationName,
AST.STATION_NAME AS arrivalStationName
FROM ROUTE R
LEFT JOIN STATION DS
ON R.DEPARTURE_STATION_ID = DS.STATION_ID
LEFT JOIN STATION AST
ON R.ARRIVAL_STATION_ID = AST.STATION_ID
WHERE R.SCHEDULE_SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
ORDER BY R.ROUTE_SEQ
